captions.detailed: A flat, rectangular grey plate containing several lines of raised Braille characters. The base slab is thin and wide, serving as a clean background canvas. The Braille dots are arranged in standard multi-row configurations, protruding slightly from the surface of the slab with distinct spacing. The overall layout mimics a printed page of tactile text, aligned horizontally across the plate.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric Braille text generator in OpenSCAD. The script should render a flat rectangular base slab and place raised Braille characters on top of it. It must support multiple lines of text, with adjustable parameters for dot radius, dot height, character width, line height, and slab dimensions.
captions.factory: The design uses a thin 'cube' primitive to act as the base slab. Individual Braille dots are generated using 'cylinder' or 'sphere' primitives depending on the version. A lookup table maps characters to their standard 6-dot Braille positions. The text is assembled by iterating through each character and line using nested loops, translating each dot to its relative position, and placing the final translated text block on top of the base slab.
